text.en:
Creation of the Schistosomiasis Control Council. The National Schistosomiasis Control
Commission created under Republic Act Numbered four thousand three hundred fifty-nine is hereby abolished
and in lieu thereof, there is hereby created the Schistosomiasis Control Council hereinafter called the Council,
which shall be attached to the Department of Health.
The powers, functions, balance of appropriations, records, assets, as well as the rights and obligations of the
National Schistosomiasis Control Commission are hereby transferred to, vested in, and assumed by the

Functions and Objectives of the Council. The Council shall have the following functions and
objectives:
(a) Formulate an integrated national program for the control of schistosomiasis in the Philippines;
(b) Coordinate and integrate the implementation of schistosomiasis control program, projects and activities of
all agencies and intrumentalities of the government as well as those of the private sector involved in
controlling the disease;
(c) Formulate an effective information and education campaign scheme and other such complementary
schemes necessary for the control of the disease;
(d) Promote special studies and researchers on related aspects of schistosomiasis control and treatment;
(e) Represent the government in its dealings with the World Health Organization or with the United Nations
International Children's Emergency Fund or any other international health agencies or entities or with foreign
governments or their agencies in matters involving schistosomiasis control, subject to existing laws, rules and
regulations; and
(f) Undertake such other activity as may be deemed necessary for the attainment of the objectives of the

Organization of the Council. To carry out its foregoing functions and objectives, the Council
shall have a Board of Directors, an Executive Committee, and a Technical Staff.

The Board of Directors. The Board of Directors which shall be the policy-making and governing
body of the Council, shall be composed of seven (7) members namely: the Secretary of Health as Chairman,
the Secretary of Public Works Transportation and Communications, the Secretary of Local Governments and
Community Development, the Secretary of Agriculture, the Administrator of the National Irrigation
Administration, the Secretary of Education and Culture and the President of the Philippine Medical
Association as members.
In case of the absence of the Chairman, the members shall choose among themselves a temporary Chairman
who shall take his place and perform his functions and duties, as provided for under this decree.
The Board of Directors shall have the following functions and powers:
(a) Approve and adopt the integrated national schistosomiasis control program envisioned in this Decree;
(b) Consider and adopt periodic reports on the status of the aforementioned program;
(c) Adopt broad policies and guidelines to carry out the goals and objectives of the Schistosomiasis Control
(d) Adopt such rules, regulations and procedures as maybe necessary for the attainment of the objectives of
this Decree; and
(e) Perform such other functions as may be provided by law.

The Executive Committee. The Executive Committee shall be headed by an Executive Director
and composed of representatives each coming from and designated by the government agencies represented in
the Board of Directors and three (3) other representatives each coming from the National Economic and
Development Authority, the Department of Social Welfare and the Budget Commission. The said
representatives who must not be the heads of the aforementioned agencies, can act in behalf of their respective
agencies only on matters involving the formulation and execution of the integrated national schistosomiasis
control program and related projects and activities envisioned in this Decree. The Chairman, upon the
recommendation of the Board of Directors, shall appoint the Executive Director and determine his
qualifications and compensation.
The Executive Committee shall have the following powers and functions:
(a) Review and recommend for approval and adoption by the Board of Directors the schistosomiasis control
program prepared by the Technical Staff;
(b) Review periodic reports prepared by the Technical Staff for the consideration and approval of the Board of
(c) Provide guidelines for the operations and activities of the Technical Staff;
(d) Act and decide on matters referred to it by the Technical Staff for its consideration; and
(e) Perform such other functions as may be assigned to it by the Board of Directors and/or the Chairman.

The Technical Staff. The Council shall have a Technical Staff, likewise to be headed by the
Executive Director of the Executive Committee. The Chairman, upon recommendation of the Executive
Committee, shall appoint the members of the technical staff. The technical positions of said staff shall be
exempt from the rules and regulations of the Wage and Position Classification Office and from the
examination and/or eligibility requirements of the Civil Service Commission.
The Technical Staff shall have the following functions and responsibilities:
(a) Undertake the preparations of a coordinated schistosomiasis control program for the approval and adoption
by the Board of Directors;

(b) Determine the linkages for the effective coordination and implementation of schistosomiasis control
(c) Establish and maintain an up-to-date and comprehensive data system on the status of the disease
specifying the areas affected, the number of people, the deaths caused by the disease and other relevant
information;
(d) Prepare periodic reports on the implementation of the program as well as the projects and activities
relating thereto for the approval and adoption by the Board of Directors; and
(e) Perform such other functions as may be assigned to it by the Board of Directors and/or the Executive
For the purpose of the foregoing functions and responsibilities, the Council may likewise utilize the services
of the Schistosomiasis Control and Research Service of the Department and if deemed necessary, secure the
detail to the Council of personnel from the said service unit.
The Council shall also hire such personnel, including consultants, as may be necessary for the performance of
its functions, who shall be appointed by the Chairman.

Meetings. The Board of Directors and the Executive Committee shall hold meetings whenever
necessary. For official meetings of either bodies, the presence of a majority of their respective members shall
constitute the quorum to do business and all its decision shall be concurred in by at least the majority of the
The members of the Board of Directors and the Executive Committee shall receive a reasonable amount of per
diem as the Board may provide for every meeting actually attended by them.

Essential Project Element. All agro-engineering projects, especially in endemic and potentially
endemic areas identified by the Council from time to time, shall always have schistosoma control components.

Reports. Within three months after the end of every fiscal year, the Council shall submit to the
President of the Philippines thru the National Economic and Development Authority its annual report
embodying the status of its programs and projects as well as its problems and recommendations. It shall
likewise submit the President or by the National Economic and Development Authority.

Role of Implementing Agencies. All government agencies concerned shall be responsible for
the implementation of the projects assigned to them. All other government agencies and instrumentalities,
including government-owned and controlled corporations, as well as the private sector, shall support the
projects of the Council for the control of the disease.

Authority to Receive Gifts and Donations. The Council is hereby authorized to receive gifts,
donations or bequests and utilize the same for the implementation of its schistosomiasis control program and
projects, in accordance with the terms of the gift, donation or bequest. Such gifts, donations or bequests shall
be exempt from all taxes, duties, dues or fees, whatsoever, imposed or hereafter to be imposed by the national
government, its agencies, instrumentalities or political subdivisions, and the same shall be fully deductible
from the gross income of the donor or grantor for income tax purposes.

Appropriations. There is hereby appropriated the sum of one million pesos out of the funds in
the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated for the operation of the Schistosomiasis Control Council and
its projects for fiscal year 1975-76. Thereafter, such amounts as shall be needed for the continued operation of
the Council and its projects shall be regularly included in subsequent annual General Appropriation Acts.
The government agencies represented in and composing the Council as indicated in Section 4 and 5 hereof are
herein after authorized to include in their respective regular annual appropriations such additional amount as
may be deemed needed to be used exclusively in undertaking their activities involving the integrated national
schistosomiasis control program provided for in this Decree.

Repealing Clause. Republic Act Numbered four thousand three hundred and fifty-nine is
hereby repealed. Likewise, any provision of law, decree, rules and regulations inconsistent herewith is hereby
repealed, amended or revised accordingly.

Separability Clause. If for any reason any section or provision of this Decree is declared to be
unconstitutional or invalid, the other sections or provisions hereof which are not affected thereby shall
continue in full force and effect.

Effectivity. This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 16th day of February in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-six.
